messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu1/model-service canary 1.2.4 -> 1.2.4-hotfix failing health checks (502 spike). logs: https://deploy.internal/5456789012 :rotating_light:

michael: seeing uptick in 502s for embeddings around 11:22 UTC — small but user-facing.

sara: please pause rollout and triage. tagging @ops-oncall for expedited hotfix approval.

ops-oncall: oncall ack. need owner + pm signoff for fasttrack. rollback options?

emily: quick triage suggests double kvcache invalidation during prefix migration in 1.2.4. can reproduce locally.

pranav: hotfix ready: add idempotent guard to invalidate path. local tests green, build artifact ready.

lina: pm signoff: approve fasttrack canary pin to v1.2.4-hotfix. low business risk. :white_check_mark:

michael: canary plan: 5% x5m, 20% x10m. auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% above baseline or P95 +50ms.

ops-oncall: agree. I'll monitor dashboards; auto-rollback to v1.2.3 on breach.

emily: deploying: `/deploy eu1 model-service canary --tag v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21 --percent 5 --pin true`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by emily. Canary at 5% (2/40). logs: https://deploy.internal/5456789012/logs

michael: quick smoke: /health OK, sample embedding queries good.

pranav: synthetic load 0/30 5xx. good. bump to 20%?

sara: go for 20% once oncall thumbs up.

ops-oncall: thumbs up. auto-rollback hook armed.

emily: `/deploy eu1 model-service canary --percent 20 --timeout 600`

deploy-bot: Canary 20%. monitoring errors/latency/kvcache-hits.

michael: metrics stable, error rate flat.

lina: release note draft: "v1.2.4-hotfix: Fix race in k-v cache invalidation during prefix migration causing intermittent 5xx in EU."

pranav: ready to promote if no regressions. promote command prepared.

ops-oncall: hold until 11:45 UTC, then promote if green.

emily: all clear at 20% after 10m. promoting to prod.

deploy-bot: Promote started. v1.2.4-hotfix -> prod eu1. Rollback target v1.2.3 configured. final logs: https://deploy.internal/5456789012/final-logs

lina: release notes set, will publish during change window.

michael: closing thread  expedited hotfix deployed, no rollback needed. thanks team. :tada:
